title: Hidden UFO side of Operation Paperclip

tellings.quote: But there's this like other side of it that a lot of it dealt with the UFO, UAP issue in earnest.

plain: A former intelligence officer named David Grusch tells Michels that Operation Paperclip, the US effort after the Second World War to bring German scientists to America, had a hidden side that dealt with UFOs. He calls these UAP, short for unidentified anomalous phenomena, the official term for UFOs, and says a lot of the work dealt with the issue "in earnest." He names the German rocket engineers Wernher von Braun and Arthur Rudolph in this connection, which would mean the US got into UFO research right after the war.
